Waypoint.name: walktocamera
Waypoint.Question: Who has the way has the hour. Take this to heart. We must all go forward or not at all.
Waypoint.Statement: We cannot know what comes until we ask. Beg like a man or cry like as fool. What will be will. Be. Hear me gods of old sumer. I await your judegement.
Waypoint.Response: I understand what you're saying. It's a quote from Winston Churchill, isn't it? "We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills; we shall never surrender." I'm trying to recall if that's exactly what you said... (pause) Yes, I believe you're right. We do have a choice to make here, don't we?
